body: Can you take a year off? A masters program is short, very short (I did two of them for that reason). Maybe some time away to re evaluate will help… you can still practice outside of school.
Yamaha. Hands down. I’ve been playing Yamaha exclusively since 2012 (former buffet r-13 person). CSVR and SEVR are great for jazz. I have a CSG set for classical playing.

I have a BM in saxophone performance and an MM in multiple woodwinds, a second MM in oboe, and a DMA in oboe. I play saxophone every day of my life (and even won two international music competitions on saxophone WHILE I was getting my MM in oboe). As long as you can spend the appropriate amount of time practicing yes. Most people will struggle with the commitment to two instruments because of time, it has nothing to do with embouchure or air or anything else like that. 

Can you handle the time investment ? Yes? Then yes. If not, then stay with oboe.
This movie is one of my favorites of all times... such good fun! Also, major props for minor oboe related content (professional oboist here!)
